content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?FOX 13's Paul Dellegatto's PostFOX 13's Paul Dellegatto Verified accountApril 1 at 3:06 PM · Shared with PublicArtemis will be visible in the sky from near Tallahassee to Savannah to near Miami. We will have the best views here in central Florida, especially in our eastern counties. Assuming a 6:24 PM launch, there will be some clouds around and a couple of showers due to maximum daytime heating. Hopefully, there will be enough blue sky to allow us a great view here in central Florida.
